deviations.D-engine: Engine check label agreement with iteration 7: P-twin 0.94 (byte-identical 0.54; correct BFS 10 vs 11), P-DAS-bfs 1.00 (byte-identical 0.78; correct BFS 39 vs 42), G1c 1.00 (byte-identical 0.68; correct BFS 32 vs 35); below 0.95 for at least one cell: kernel sensitivity (RTX 4090 vs RTX 2000 Ada), continued as committed.
deviations.D-U3p: U3' (decode-time hook vs prefilled-path edit at index 32): |dm| up to 0.42 nat with the DAS edit (plain path 0.19); above the 0.3 nat tolerance, logged and not fatal as committed; P4 measures the consequence.
deviations.D-maxnew: max_new 1024 (protocol v8: 1,536 for path tasks) kept so iteration 7's record cells are reproducible slot for slot; truncated programs: 0/1320.
deviations.D-seed: Generation uses DAS seed 0 (the seed whose prefilled dose curve is on record), not the median seed; seed 2 runs teacher-forced at every rank and as the optional free cell.
deviations.D-rule: Refined decision-position rule (body-indent previous token, live ' visited' p_D >= 0.01, no algorithm-identifying string) instead of the literal rule; literal rule reported as a diagnostic.
deviations.D-targets: DAS class targets: seed 0 k <= 4 use commit3's coordinates (iteration-7 states); other seeds/ranks and the TF dormancy use this engine's recomputed states.
deviations.D-method-edit: method.py was edited after commit #0 to save block-17 decision-position states for the geometry figure (stage commit2) and to add two exploratory stages, each committed before it ran: gpu_extra (commit #3, free prompting across 8 wordings) and tf_extra (commit #4, layer sweep of full-state swaps); after the run the input-artifact paths were made portable (one artifact_dir() constant per input artifact: environment variable, sibling folder named by the id, or the run-volume layout); no committed statistic or rule changed.
deviations.D-pca-upper: Two 'pca_upper' quantities are reported: the plan's ||U64^T R_k||_F^2 / k (fraction of R_k inside the top-64 natural PCs) and E33's top-k PC variance share of the natural set; the committed rule uses neither (it uses retention).
deviations.D-iter7-cause: Iteration 7 attributed the 0/125 pass of ' queue' programs to slowness; re-running the frozen hidden tests shows they fail on wall cases (wrong answer, no wall check of start/goal), not on time (see analysis.json failure_reasons).

entries.title: Faithful Bi-Directional Model Steering via Distribution Matching and Distributed Interchange Interventions (CDAS; ICLR 2026)
entries.verdict: occupies 'DAS-style distributed interchange interventions used for steering and validated by generation'; adjacent to this artifact, which adds a prefill-matched prompting 2x2 on CRN slots at one algorithmic fork, a free-generation decision-position edit and dormancy checks
quotes: we build on the principles of distributed alignment search (DAS), the standard for causal variable localization, to propose a new steering method: Concept DAS (CDAS)
it uses DIIs that naturally enable bi-directional steering and allow steering factors to be derived from data
CDAS achieves systematic steering while maintaining general model utility

entries.title: MIB: A Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark
entries.verdict: adjacent: motivates DAS as the causal-variable localiser; MIB evaluates localisation by interchange accuracy, not by generated-program outcomes against a prompting baseline
quotes: For causal variable localization, we find that the supervised DAS method performs best, while SAE features are not better than neurons, i.e., non-featurized hidden vectors.

entries.title: Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for? An Interpretability Illusion for Subspace Activation Patching (Makelov, Lange, Geiger, Nanda; ICLR 2024)
entries.verdict: adjacent (method source): the dormant/disconnected decomposition and the restricted-patch check that G3 (ii)-(iii) operationalise
quotes: this effect may be achieved by activating a _dormant parallel pathway_ leveraging another subspace that is _causally disconnected_ from model outputs
the h2h_{2} direction is dormant: it is constant (always 00) on the data, but setting it to some other value will affect the model's output

entries.title: A Reply to Makelov et al. (2023)'s 'Interpretability Illusion' Arguments
entries.verdict: adjacent: the counter-position that the illusion criterion can reject desirable explanations; relevant to reading the DORMANT verdict on the twin-only natural set
quotes: we show that even intuitive and desirable explanations can qualify as illusions in this sense
the illusions Makelov et al. (2023) see in practice are artifacts of their training and evaluation paradigms

entries.title: The Non-Linear Representation Dilemma: Is Causal Abstraction Enough for Mechanistic Interpretability?
entries.verdict: adjacent: the reason the map class is fixed (linear, orthonormal, rank <= 8) and the RINIT/SHUF controls were run in iteration 7
quotes: causal abstraction is not enough for mechanistic interpretability, as it becomes vacuous without assumptions about how models encode information
our alignment maps reach 100\% interchange-intervention accuracy on the indirect object identification task

entries.title: AxBench: Steering LLMs? Even Simple Baselines Outperform Sparse Autoencoders
entries.verdict: adjacent: the prior that prompting beats steering; here it holds in free generation (dial vs prompt not distinguishable) and fails under a c* prefill
quotes: For steering, we find that prompting outperforms all existing methods, followed by finetuning.

entries.title: One Token Can Be Enough: Bridging Prompting and Activation Steering with Prefix Steering
entries.verdict: adjacent, closest prior: a brief (even single-token) steering intervention at the final prompt token that alters later generation, compared with prompting across four models and five tasks; it does not use a causally localised (DAS) subspace, a CRN-paired prefill-matched prompting cell, a decision position read off the model's own trajectory, or hidden-test program correctness
quotes: We study Prefix Steering, which applies existing steering directions and operators over a short span starting at the final prompt token, with no further direct intervention afterward.
intervention over a short span, even a single token, often retains much of full steering's behavioral control while better preserving general capabilities

entries.title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting (ICML 2026)
entries.verdict: adjacent: prompt steering as activation steering; supports the reading that a prompt acts at many positions while the dial acts at one
quotes: popular activation steering methods are not faithful to the mechanics of prompt steering, which applies strong interventions on some tokens while barely affecting others

entries.title: DecodeShare: Tracing the Shared Subspace of LLM Decode-Time Decisions
entries.verdict: adjacent: decode-time vs prefill evaluation of steering; this artifact's U3' offset and prefilled-vs-free contrast are a concrete instance
quotes: evaluating steering vectors at decode-time yields more reliable signal for downstream deployment than prefill-based proxies

entries.title: Addressing divergent representations from causal interventions on neural networks
entries.verdict: adjacent: off-distribution ('divergent') intervention states; the projected-retention result (most of the DAS effect lies outside the twins' natural span) is an instance of the divergence they describe
quotes: common causal intervention techniques often do shift internal representations away from the natural distribution of the target model
"pernicious" divergences that activate hidden network pathways and cause dormant behavioral changes

entries.title: Exploring Diverse Generation Paths via Inference-time Stiefel Activation Steering (STARS)
entries.verdict: adjacent to the run's creativity question (diversity by steering), irrelevant to the fork-dial claims
quotes: Language models often default to a narrow set of high-probability outputs, leaving their generation paths homogeneous and prone to mode collapse.

entries.title: Watch the Model Think: On-Policy Extraction of Activation Steering Vectors (ROAST)
entries.verdict: adjacent: on-policy (trajectory-based) steering directions; here the direction is fitted off-policy (forced prompts) and applied on-policy at a decision position
quotes: ROAST makes the trajectory itself the contrast: sample rollouts, let an outcome verifier split them into successes and failures, and contrast the reasoning that worked against the reasoning that did not.
